text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since the Summer Training Camp, her rival 
Biwa Hayahide has grown remarkably 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whether in the races they ran together in 
their youth, or now. She stands tall 
before Narita Taishin as a massive wall.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket's positive fighting spirit, 
undaunted even by Biwa Hayahide, also made 
Narita Taishin feel terribly impatient.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afraid of being the only one left behind— 
Driven by impatience to push herself too 
far, Narita Taishin ends up wrecking her 
body.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"All I have is racing... All I can do is 
run and win!" With tears welling in her 
eyes, Narita Taishin pleaded to be entered 
into the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer could not bring themselves to 
brush aside her sorrowful wish.
